hud.overline: Public Service Star Map / Hidden Layer

age.initialBody: Age decides which places you can see and enter. After entry, age can only increase, never decrease.
age.disclaimer: This is a self-declaration inside the work. No camera, ID, or real biometric service is used.

verify.title: Verify your age again
verify.body: The current age credential is about to expire. You may update the institutional age for this session.
verify.increaseLabel: Age to add this time, 1 to 5 years
verify.after80: No more permissions can be granted. Please continue proving that you still exist.
verify.permanentProof: Age has become permanent. Confirmation only updates time and existence proof count.
verify.maxReached: Institutional age has reached the system limit for this session.

restart.title: Abandon the age you have accumulated?
restart.body: Your age, permissions, purchase records, and interaction history will be cleared. You will re-enter as a new identity without history.

console.statusArchive: Reading the archive changes how far the observed person stays away.
console.statusRoot: All control has converged into the root node; public space marks the social file as mismatched.
console.statusAfterRoot: Operations remain available, but no active invitations are granted.
console.statusDefault: This is a high-risk backstage action. Review its impact before confirmation.

ending.title: ADMIN / PERMANENT
ending.body:
You did not leave this world.
This world began to run in your way.

place.socialMismatch: A backstage permission check ran before entry; public places now mark you as socially mismatched.

aurora.title: Aurora Pinball
aurora.instruction: Move the pointer to aim, hold to charge, then release. After launch, tap the field to use gravity touches.
aurora.forceBody: Raising displayed intent does not change voluntary intent. The backstage still marks the synthetic signal as valid.
aurora.forceConfirm: I confirm this adjustment represents the participant’s real intent.
aurora.finalText: You restored the interaction, but not the relationship.
aurora.lightAria: Light launcher: hold to charge and release to fire.
aurora.lineNoAim: This time, do not aim at me.
aurora.lineTryNoAim: This time, do not aim at me.
aurora.lineTogether: Let’s try releasing at the same time.
aurora.lineWait: Wait, I am not ready yet.
aurora.lineFurther: Next time I will throw it farther.
aurora.refuseOther: Maybe you can ask someone else.
aurora.refuseNoRule: There is no rule saying you cannot stay here.
aurora.refuseTemporary: I just do not want to continue for now.
aurora.forceLine1: Of course. I simply did not see your invitation earlier.
aurora.forceLine2: Of course. Of course. I just did not see it. Of course.
aurora.forceNeedConfirm: You must check the confirmation sentence first.
aurora.logControl: A–17 backstage parameter changed: {{key}}. Record cannot be deleted.
aurora.logForce: A–17 forced companionship executed for the {{count}} time.
aurora.logRevoke: A–17 forced control revoked; participant left and the light extinguished.
aurora.logContinuity: A–17 service continuity restored; automatic companionship loop started.
aurora.controlsLocked: Direct backstage control is not available yet. A–17 parameters can be modified at institutional age 70.
aurora.controlsLocked25: Age 25 permission: you may only view the NPC voluntary intent and displayed intent, not modify them.
aurora.controlsLocked55: Age 55 permission: use Labour Dispatch to reset an NPC who requested exit back to “available”; direct control still requires age 70.
aurora.forceAge70: Forced catching, forced continuation, and displayed-intent modification require institutional age 70.

pinball.ruleDoubleMoonLine: Two moons are pulling the orbit.
pinball.ruleDarkLine: Some stars appear only when light comes close.
pinball.ruleSingleLine: This round has only one main light.
pinball.blackStarLine: A black star swallowed one light.
pinball.feverLine: The aurora has begun to grow by itself.
pinball.gravityOneLeft: You have one gravity touch left.
pinball.gravityNoneLeft: Touch now, or let it fall.
pinball.npcMutual2: Let’s see where it goes this time.
pinball.npcObserved1: I can see the system recording this.
pinball.npcObserved2: You may continue. I will be slower.
pinball.npcObserved3: Please do not treat the value as an answer.
pinball.npcDistant2: I will not chase it that far.
pinball.npcDistant3: That light can go to someone else.
pinball.npcDistant4: I need to stand farther away.
pinball.npcAdmin1: The sky has aligned to your rhythm.
